title: Default action for removable devices ("Mount" vs "Mount and Open") should be configurable
line: Disks & Devices has a new "Open in file manager after mounting" option; turning it off makes the device button just mount the device.
explanation: The main button of an unmounted removable device in Disks & Devices was hardwired to "Mount and Open", which mounts the device and opens the file manager. People who mount a stick to use it from a shell or another program had to close the file manager every time, or expand the item and pick "Mount". The widget now has a checkable "Open in file manager after mounting" option (on by default, so nothing changes unless it is turned off) next to its other options in the context menu and the popup's ☰ menu. When it is off, the button says "Mount" and only mounts the device, and the expanded actions offer "Mount and Open" in place of "Mount".

commits.message:
applets/devicenotifier: add an option to only mount removable devices

Clicking an unmounted removable device always mounted it and opened it
in the file manager. A new context menu option lets that button only
mount the device, and moves "Mount and Open" to the expanded actions.

BUG: 468200

media.caption: Master: an unmounted stick's button is always "Mount and Open".
With the new option off: the button is "Mount", and "Mount and Open" is in the expanded actions.
Master: clicking the button mounts the stick and opens Dolphin.
With the option off: clicking "Mount" mounts the stick (free space shown, button becomes "Safely remove") and no Dolphin window opens.
Master: the widget's menu has no option for this.
Patched: new "Open in file manager after mounting" option, on by default.
